# Setup: Windows

Windows is supported but **not tested regularly**. Linux is the primary
platform. We use [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/) because it is open source and
gives a build environment consistent with Linux.

## 1. Install MSYS2

Download and install MSYS2 from <https://www.msys2.org/>.

## 2. Install the toolchain

Open the **UCRT64** shell (not MSYS or MINGW64) and run:

```bash
pacman -S --needed git \
    mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc \
    mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-cmake \
    mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-ninja \
    mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-SDL2
```

## 3. Clone and build

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate.git
cd FreeOpenSourceSyndicate
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DFOSS_BUILD_GAME=ON
cmake --build build
```

## 4. Run

```bash
./build/src/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate.exe
```

Controls (prototype): left-click a tile to move the selected agent, **Tab** to
select the next agent, arrow keys to scroll, **Esc** to quit.

## 5. Test

```bash
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Core-only build (no SDL2 needed)

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DFOSS_BUILD_GAME=OFF
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Troubleshooting

### `SDL2 not found`

Make sure you are in the **UCRT64** shell and that
`mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-SDL2` is installed. Mixing MSYS/MINGW64/UCRT64 packages
is a common cause of link errors.

### Running from Explorer

The executable may need the MinGW runtime DLLs on `PATH`. Running from the
MSYS2 UCRT64 shell avoids this. For a standalone build, copy the required
`libgcc`/`libstdc++`/`SDL2` DLLs next to the `.exe`.
